name: DYING_CAMP
canonical: the snakebitten Israelite camp in the wilderness, a sprawl of dusty goat-hair tents and stricken Hebrew wanderers in coarse earth-toned robes, gaunt fevered faces and writhing fallen bodies clutching swollen serpent-bitten limbs, the dying and grieving strewn across the cracked desert ground under a harsh sky
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
